tool.name: Haddock3Accessibility
tool.description: : Wrapper class for the Haddock-Restraints Accessibility module.

param.name: input_pdb_path
param.label: input PDB file
param.help: Path to the input PDB file. Format: [input].pdb

param.name: outname_output_accessibility_path
param.label: output TXT,DAT,OUT name
param.help: Path to the output file with accessibility information Format: [output].[format]

param.name: outname_output_actpass_path
param.label: output TXT,DAT,OUT name
param.help: Path to the output file with active/passive residues to be used as haddock3 restraint information Format: [output].[format]

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: chain
param.label: chain
param.help: Chain to be used from the input PDB file.

param.name: probe_radius
param.label: probe_radius
param.help: Probe radius for the accessibility calculation.

param.name: pass_to_act
param.label: pass_to_act
param.help: If True, the passive residues become active in the actpass file and vice versa.

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: Path to the haddock haddock executable binary.
